snippets.non_accrual: cash. Management considers portfolio company-specific circumstances as well as other economic factors in determining the collectability of interest income. As of June 30, 2026, the Company had loans to five portfolio companies that were on non-accrual status, which represented approximately 8.5% of the Company’s total investments at cost and 5.4% at fair value.

notes: No weighted-average risk rating found (many BDCs do not disclose one).
